messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers working late-night shifts experience eye strain from the platform's bright interface, and the lack of a dark mode option reduces comfort and usability during extended evening work sessions. Selsby Motor reports running claims reports late into the evening and says the bright interface is straining their eyes [i:1047ddd358940268]. The same account handles a lot of late-night reserves and payments and says eye comfort matters [i:2f35eeab8fe49055].\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Selsby Motor, an account with 190000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal date of 2027-09-27, raised this issue 4 times [i:1047ddd358940268].\n- The account's late-night claims reporting and reserves/payments work is the context for the eye-strain complaint [i:2f35eeab8fe49055].\n- The account has adopted a temporary workaround of tweaking monitor settings while waiting for updates on dark mode [i:b17eb0096d8122df].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Selsby Motor asked whether dark mode could be enabled because running claims reports late into the evening was straining their eyes [i:1047ddd358940268].\n- Selsby Motor stated that they handle a lot of late-night reserves and payments, that eye comfort matters, and asked for a timeline or workaround [i:2f35eeab8fe49055].\n- Selsby Motor said they would tweak monitor settings for now and wait for updates on dark mode [i:b17eb0096d8122df].\n- A near-duplicate report from the same account repeats the late-evening claims reporting and eye-strain request [i:d05a47821fefe6a2].\n- As of 2026-11-03, this opportunity covers 1 account, 4 mentions, and 1 route, all on support; there are 0 renewals in the next 90 days [i:1047ddd358940268].\n\n## Why now\n\n- The account's renewal date is 2027-09-27, and it has 190000.0 GBP in ARR, so the request is tied to a long-lived account rather than an imminent renewal [i:b17eb0096d8122df].\n- The account has already accepted a manual workaround, which means the underlying request remains open [i:b17eb0096d8122df].\n- All 4 mentions arrived through the support route, and no other routes are represented in the fact sheet [i:1047ddd358940268].\n",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "1047ddd358940268",
   "quote": "we’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes. Any chance we can get dark mode enabled?",
   "account": "Selsby Motor",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-29T16:20:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "id": "2f35eeab8fe49055",
   "quote": "We handle a lot of late-night reserves and payments, so eye comfort matters. Let me know if there’s a timeline or workaround.",
   "account": "Selsby Motor",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-29T16:20:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "id": "b17eb0096d8122df",
   "quote": "We’ll tweak the monitor settings for now and wait for updates on dark mode.",
   "account": "Selsby Motor",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-29T16:20:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "id": "d05a47821fefe6a2",
   "quote": "We’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes — any chance we can get dark mode enabled?",
   "account": "Selsby Motor",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-29T16:20:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 4,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "support": 4
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 190000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Selsby Motor",
    "arr_gbp": 190000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-09-27",
    "mentions": 4
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the ARR and renewal figures against the fact sheet (190000.0 GBP, 2027-09-27) and the mention/route counts (4 mentions, 1 route, all support, 0 renewals in 90 days), all of which match. Paraphrases of the cited quotes (eye strain from claims reports, late-night reserves and payments, monitor-settings workaround) are accurately represented without quotation-mark misuse. One weakness: the 'Why now' section attributes the ARR and renewal date to [i:b17eb0096d8122df], which does not contain those facts, though the facts themselves are correct per the fact sheet, so this is a citation mismatch rather than an unsupported or false claim.","verdict": "pass"}
